title: Can't stop "pump unreachable" alarm
symptom: User gets a 'pump unreachable' alarm that beeps repeatedly in the middle of the night. Pressing OK or doing a manual refresh does not stop it; there is no visible window with buttons to stop it. Swiping away AAPS messages, refreshing pod status, or quitting AAPS via the 3-dots menu does not stop the alarm (AAPS restarts itself and the alarm continues, sometimes with a different sound). Only force stopping AAPS and clearing cache memory stops the alarm.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer (MilosKozak) commented 'it seems to be only concurrecy issue...' after reviewing logs, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. Workarounds mentioned by the user include force stopping AAPS and clearing cache, or quitting AAPS via the 3-dots menu (which sometimes stops the alarm immediately). The maintainer made logging improvements and asked for new logs, but no permanent fix is provided.
evidence_quote: I had to force stop AAPS and empty cache memory to stop the alarm.
